analysis_result.analysis: The model’s reasoning is fundamentally flawed due to misperception of the structure’s scale — it incorrectly assumed a 3×3×3 grid instead of the actual 6×4×6 grid. This led to a severe undercount of visible green cubes (7 vs. ground truth 15). Even though the model correctly identified green cubes by color, it failed to perceive the full scope of the structure and thus miscounted. This is primarily a PERCEPTION error (missed objects due to incorrect structural assumption) compounded by a REASONING error in counting.
